units.en: In this way both military and civilian interests would be served, and practice would match principle.'
units.literal: Thus both military and civilian interests might benefit, and name and reality would correspond.'

units.zh: 其練丁口糧，若太多，則與募勇之價相等，不必僅以團名；
units.en: If militiamen's rations are too high, they cost as much as recruited braves and the 'militia' label means little;
units.literal: If militiamen's rations are too high, they equal the price of recruited braves and need not be called militia only;

units.zh: 若太少，則與官勇之餉迥殊，不能得其死力。
units.en: if too low, they fall far below official braves' pay and will not fight to the death.
units.literal: if too low, they differ greatly from official braves' pay and their utmost loyalty cannot be obtained.

units.zh: 其團防經費，若取諸丁、漕、釐、捐四者之中，則有礙督撫籌款之途；
units.en: If militia funds come from land tax, grain transport, transit levies, or donations, they interfere with the governors' own revenue;
units.literal: If militia defense funds are taken from land tax, grain transport, transit levies, and donations, they obstruct governors' fundraising;

units.zh: 若設法四者之外，則更無措手之處。
units.en: and if you look beyond those four sources, there is nowhere else to turn.
units.literal: if sought beyond these four, there is no other means at hand.

units.zh: 事權既無專屬，剛柔實覺兩難。
units.en: With no clear authority, it is impossible to strike the right balance between firmness and flexibility.
units.literal: With no exclusive authority, firmness and flexibility both feel impossible.

units.zh: 晏端書在江北不設餉局，但勸各邑築圩自保，龐鍾璐在江南激勸鄉民，俾知同仇敵愾之義，辦理極有斟酌。
units.en: Yan Duanshu in Jiangbei created no pay bureau but urged counties to build dikes for self-defense; Pang Zhonglu in Jiangnan roused villagers to shared resolve—both handled matters with notable restraint.
units.literal: Yan Duanshu in Jiangbei set up no pay bureau but urged each county to build dikes for self-defense; Pang Zhonglu in Jiangnan stirred village people to understand shared enmity—both handled matters with great discretion.

units.zh: 今之賊勢，決非鄉團所能奏功。
units.en: Today's rebels are far too strong for village militia to defeat.
units.literal: Today's rebel strength absolutely cannot be overcome by village militia.

units.zh: 應俟賊氛稍衰，大功將成，然後辦團練以善其後。
units.en: Militia should wait until rebel strength fades and final victory is near, then be organized properly to secure the aftermath.
units.literal: Militia training should wait until rebel strength declines somewhat and great success is near, then organize militia to finish matters properly.

units.zh: 晏端書、龐鍾璐二員，清操雅望，內任最宜。
units.en: Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu, both men of integrity and reputation, are best suited for posts in the capital.
units.literal: Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu—both men of pure conduct and lofty reputation—are most suited for capital appointments.

units.zh: 應請裁去團練差使，回京供職。」
units.en: Their militia commissions should be abolished and they should return to the capital.'
units.literal: Their militia commissions should be abolished and they should return to the capital for duty.'

units.zh: 晏端書差。四月癸亥王茂蔭署左副都御史。
units.en: Yan Duanshu was on assignment. On the guihai day of the fourth month, Wang Maoyin served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Yan Duanshu was on assignment. On the guihai day of the fourth month, Wang Maoyin served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 同治元年壬戌
units.en: First year of the Tongzhi reign (renxu)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 1, renxu

units.zh: 十年，諭勝保等督辦鄉團，以資統率，酌定章程，凡辦團州縣一律遵行，惟鄉團更番調營，所領糧餉，易滋流弊，毋得冒濫。
units.en: In the tenth year, Senggebao and others were appointed to oversee village militia and draw up regulations for every participating county—but when militia rotated through camp duty, rations were easily abused, and padding the rolls was forbidden.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Senggebao and others were ordered to supervise village militia for unified command; regulations were drawn up for all counties organizing militia to follow uniformly. However, when village militia rotated in turns to camp duty, the rations they received easily bred abuses, and padding must not be allowed.

units.zh: 前統兵大臣勝保，因調團不齊，勒派百姓出資雇丁，統計勇糧運費，較正供多至倍蓰，百姓苦累，紛紛稟請，以抽丁一項，民力已竭，鄉團勢難再辦。
units.en: Former commander Senggebao, unable to mobilize militia uniformly, had forced commoners to fund hired braves—grain and transport costs ran to several times normal revenue. The people petitioned in droves that conscription alone had exhausted them and village militia could no longer be raised.
units.literal: The former commander Senggebao, because militia mobilization was incomplete, had forced commoners to contribute funds to hire braves; counting brave rations and transport costs, the total exceeded regular revenue by as much as several times; the people suffered grievously and petitioned in numbers, stating that conscription alone had exhausted popular strength and that village militia could hardly be organized again.

units.zh: 勝保等所辦章程既與民心不洽，自應改弦更張，以期得力。
units.en: Because the regulations Senggebao and others had drawn up ran against popular sentiment, the policy had to be changed if it was to work.
units.literal: Since the regulations organized by Senggebao and others did not accord with popular sentiment, a change of approach was naturally required to achieve effectiveness.

units.zh: 湯斌孫之旭陸隴其張伯行
units.en: Tang Bin, his grandson Zhixu, Lu Longqi, and Zhang Boxing
units.literal: Tang Bin, grandson Zhixu, Lu Longqi, Zhang Boxing

units.zh: 湯斌，字孔伯，河南睢州人。
units.en: Tang Bin, whose style was Kongbo, came from Suizhou in Henan.
units.literal: Tang Bin, style name Kongbo, was a native of Suizhou in Henan.

units.zh: 朕聞​​湯斌從孫奇逢學，有操守，可補江寧巡撫。」
units.en: I am told Tang Bin studied with Sun Qifeng and has real integrity. He should take Jiangning."
units.literal: I have heard that Tang Bin studied under Sun Qifeng and has integrity; he may fill the Jiangning governorship."

units.zh: 父契祖，挈斌避兵浙江衢州。
units.en: His father Qizu took him to Quzhou in Zhejiang to escape the fighting.
units.literal: His father Qizu took Bin and fled the warfare to Quzhou in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 方議修明史，斌應詔言：「宋史修於元至正，而不諱文天祥、謝枋得之忠；
units.en: While plans were being made to compile the Ming History, Bin answered an imperial summons with a memorial: "The Song History was written under the Yuan, yet it still honored Wen Tianxiang and Xie Fangde for their loyalty;
units.literal: When the Ming History was under discussion for compilation, Bin responded to an imperial edict, saying: "The Song History was compiled in the Zhizheng era of Yuan, yet it did not conceal the loyalty of Wen Tianxiang and Xie Fangde;

units.zh: 九年，成進士，選庶吉士，授國史院檢討。
units.en: In 1652 he became a jinshi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and was made a reviser at the National History Institute.
units.literal: In the ninth year, he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor in the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed reviser of the National History Institute.

units.zh: 斌出為潼關道副使。
units.en: Bin was posted as vice commissioner of the Tongguan Circuit.
units.literal: Bin went out as vice commissioner of the Tongguan Circuit.

units.zh: 康熙十七年，詔舉博學鴻儒，尚書魏象樞、副都御史金鋐以斌薦，試一等，授翰林院侍講，與修明史。
units.en: In 1678 the court called for eminent scholars; Wei Xiangshu and Jin E recommended Bin, who ranked first in the special examination and became a Hanlin lecturer working on the Ming History.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Kangxi, an edict summoned erudite scholars; Minister Wei Xiangshu and Vice Censor-in-Chief Jin E recommended Bin; he placed first in the examination, was appointed Hanlin lecturer, and took part in compiling the Ming History.

units.zh: 服闋，聞容城孫奇逢講學夏峰，負笈往從。
units.en: After the mourning period he heard that Sun Qifeng of Rongcheng was teaching at Xiafeng and went to join him as a student.
units.literal: When mourning ended, hearing that Sun Qifeng of Rongcheng was lecturing at Xiafeng, he shouldered his books and went to study under him.

units.zh: 二十一年，命為明史總裁官，遷左庶子。
units.en: In 1682 he was named chief compiler of the Ming History and made Left Mentor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, he was appointed chief compiler of the Ming History and promoted to Left Mentor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 十六年，調江西嶺北道。
units.en: In 1659 he was transferred to the Lingbei Circuit in Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was transferred to the Lingbei Circuit of Jiangxi.

units.zh: 斌策玉廷必變計，夜馳至南安設守。
units.en: Bin judged that Yuting would renege, rode overnight to Nan'an, and organized its defense.
units.literal: Bin calculated that Yuting would change his plan, and rode through the night to Nan'an to set up defenses.

units.zh: 江寧巡撫缺，方廷推，上曰：「今以道學名者，言行或相悖。
units.en: When the Jiangning governorship fell vacant and the court was nominating candidates, the emperor remarked, "Men who parade as Neo-Confucian sages often fail to live up to their reputations.
units.literal: The Jiangning governorship was vacant and the court was deliberating candidates; the emperor said: "Those famed today for Neo-Confucian learning often contradict their words with their deeds.

units.zh: 十月，上南巡，至蘇州，諭斌曰：「向聞吳閶繁盛，今觀其風土，尚虛華，安佚樂，逐末者多，力田者寡。
units.en: In the tenth month, on his southern tour, the emperor reached Suzhou and said to Bin, "I had heard that the district around Chang Gate was thriving, but what I see is still vanity, idleness, and pleasure-seeking. Too many chase trade; too few till the soil.
units.literal: In the tenth month the emperor made a southern tour; reaching Suzhou, he told Bin: "I had heard that Wu's Chang Gate district was flourishing; now observing its customs, they are still given to empty display, ease, and pleasure—many chase secondary trades, few labor in the fields.

units.zh: 上還蹕，斌從至江寧，命還蘇州，賜御書及狐腋蟒服。
units.en: On the return journey Bin accompanied him as far as Jiangning, then was sent back to Suzhou with imperial calligraphy and a python robe lined with fox fur.
units.literal: When the emperor returned to the capital, Bin accompanied him to Jiangning; he was ordered back to Suzhou and granted imperial calligraphy and a python robe lined with fox fur.

units.zh: 順治二年，奉父還裡。
units.en: In 1645 he brought his father home.
units.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, he brought his father back home.

units.zh: 明末流賊陷睢州，母趙殉節死，事具明史列女傳。
units.en: When rebel armies overran Suizhou in the late Ming, his mother Zhao chose death rather than dishonor; her story is told in the Ming History's biographies of virtuous women.
units.literal: At the end of the Ming, roving bandits captured Suizhou; his mother Zhao died a martyr's death, the affair being recorded in the Ming History biographies of exemplary women.

units.zh: 斌念父老，以病乞休，丁父憂。
units.en: Thinking of his elderly father, Bin asked to retire on grounds of illness and then mourned his father's death.
units.literal: Bin, mindful of his aged father, pleaded illness to retire, and entered mourning for his father.

units.zh: 二十年，充日講起居注官、浙江鄉試正考官，轉侍讀。
units.en: In 1681 he became a daily lecturer and diarist of the imperial court, served as chief examiner for the Zhejiang provincial exams, and was promoted to reader.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, he served as daily lecturer and recorder of the emperor's movements, chief examiner of the Zhejiang provincial examination, and was transferred to reader.

units.zh: 二十三年，擢內閣學士。
units.en: In 1684 he was elevated to Grand Secretariat academician.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

units.zh: 大學士馮銓、金之俊謂斌獎逆，擬旨嚴飭，世祖特召至南苑慰諭之。
units.en: Grand Secretaries Feng Quan and Jin Zhijun accused him of glorifying rebellion and drafted a stern reprimand, but the Shunzhi Emperor summoned him to the Southern Park and reassured him in person.
units.literal: Grand Secretaries Feng Quan and Jin Zhijun said Bin was praising rebellion and drafted an edict of severe reprimand; the Shizu Emperor specially summoned him to the Southern Park to console and instruct him.

units.zh: 元史修於明洪武，而亦著丁好禮、巴顏布哈之義。
units.en: the Yuan History was compiled in early Ming, yet it likewise records the integrity of Ding Haoli and Bayan Buha.
units.literal: the Yuan History was compiled in the Hongwu reign of Ming, yet it also records the righteousness of Ding Haoli and Bayan Buha.

units.zh: 順治元、二年間，前明諸臣有抗節不屈、臨危致命者，不可概以叛書。
units.en: In 1644 and 1645 many former Ming officials held firm and died rather than submit; they must not all be branded as traitors in the record.
units.literal: In the first and second years of Shunzhi, among former Ming officials there were those who resisted to the end and died facing peril; they cannot all be written down as rebels.

units.zh: 宜命纂修諸臣勿事瞻顧。」
units.en: The compilers should be instructed to write without fear or favor."
units.literal: The compiling officials should be ordered not to look over their shoulders."

units.zh: 下所司。
units.en: The memorial was sent to the relevant departments.
units.literal: The matter was referred to the responsible offices.

units.zh: 總兵陳德調湖南，將二萬人至關欲留，斌以計出之，至洛陽譁潰。
units.en: Regional Commander Chen De was reassigned to Hunan but brought twenty thousand troops to Tong Pass intending to stay. Bin contrived to send them on; at Luoyang they rioted and broke apart.
units.literal: Regional Commander Chen De was transferred to Hunan; leading twenty thousand men to the pass he wished to remain, but Bin by stratagem got them out; at Luoyang they mutinied and dispersed.

units.zh: 玉廷以兵至，見有備，卻走；
units.en: Yuting marched up, found the defenses ready, and retreated;
units.literal: Yuting came with troops, saw preparations in place, and withdrew;

units.zh: 遣將追擊，獲玉廷。
units.en: Bin sent troops after him and took Yuting prisoner.
units.literal: he sent generals in pursuit and captured Yuting.

units.zh: 賜鞍馬一、表裡十、銀五百。
units.en: The emperor gave him a saddle horse, ten sets of robes, and five hundred taels of silver.
units.literal: He was granted one saddle horse, ten sets of outer and inner garments, and five hundred taels of silver.

units.zh: 复賜御書三軸，曰：「今當遠離，展此如對朕也！」
units.en: He also received three scrolls of the emperor's own writing with the message, "You are going far from court; open these as though you were standing before me!"
units.literal: He was again granted three scrolls of imperial calligraphy, reading: "You are now going far away—when you unroll these it will be as if facing me!"

units.zh: 時府、道多缺員，上以用人方亟，當得文行兼優者，以學問為經濟，選翰林官，得陳爌、黃志遴、王無咎、楊思聖、藍潤、王舜年、範週、馬燁曾、沈荃及斌凡十人。
units.en: Many prefectural and circuit posts stood empty, and the emperor wanted men of both learning and integrity who could turn scholarship to practical use. From the Hanlin Academy he chose Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yezeng, Shen Quan, and Bin—ten in all.
units.literal: At the time many prefectural and circuit posts were vacant; the emperor, urgently needing men, sought those combining literary and moral excellence, taking learning as practical statecraft, and selected Hanlin officials, obtaining Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yezeng, Shen Quan, and Bin, ten in all.

units.zh: 明將李玉廷率所部萬人據雩都山寨，約降，未及期，而鄭成功犯江寧。
units.en: The Ming loyalist Li Yuting held a mountain stronghold at Yudu with ten thousand men and had agreed to surrender, but before the deadline Zheng Chenggong struck at Jiangning.
units.literal: Ming general Li Yuting led ten thousand of his troops to hold a mountain stockade at Yudu, having agreed to surrender; before the appointed date, Zheng Chenggong attacked Jiangning.

units.zh: 瀕行，諭曰：「居官以正風俗為先。
units.en: Before he left, the emperor told him, "Your first duty in office is to set society's morals right.
units.literal: On the eve of departure he was instructed: "In office, correcting customs comes first.

units.zh: 同治元年諭曰：「馬政廢弛，積弊已深，以致軍馬罷瘠。
units.en: Tongzhi 1 (1862) brought an edict: "Horse administration has decayed; abuses run so deep that army mounts are spent and thin.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi an edict stated: "Horse administration has fallen into neglect; long-standing abuses run deep, so that military horses are exhausted and emaciated.

units.zh: 同治二年，定古北口盤獲私馬逾三十匹者送京，不及三十匹賞與兵丁，著為令。
units.en: Tongzhi 2 (1863) fixed that private horses seized at Gubeikou in lots over 30 were sent to the capital; smaller lots were rewarded to soldiers—permanent law.
units.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi it was fixed that private horses seized at Gubeikou exceeding thirty head were sent to the capital; fewer than thirty were rewarded to soldiers—established as regulation.

units.zh: 牧廠大臣等應妥實整頓，差功罪以挽頹風，著為令。」
units.en: Pasture officials must set things right, rewarding merit and punishing fault to reverse the decline—let this stand as permanent law."
units.literal: Pasture ministers and the like should thoroughly rectify matters, distinguishing merit and fault to reverse the declining trend, and this is to be established as regulation."

units.zh: 會校獵南苑，諸皇子皆從，恭親王奕訢獲禽最多，文宗未發一矢，問之，對曰：「時方春，鳥獸孳育，不忍傷生以乾天和。」
units.en: During a hunt in the Southern Park all the princes were present. Prince Gong Yixin bagged the most game, but the prince who would become Xianfeng did not shoot once. Asked why, he answered: 'It is spring; the birds and beasts are breeding. I cannot bear to kill them and offend Heaven's harmony.'
units.literal: Once during a hunting review at the Southern Park all the princes followed; Prince Gong Yixin took the most game, while Wenzong had not loosed a single arrow. When asked, he replied: 'It is now spring; birds and beasts are breeding—I cannot bear to harm living things and disturb Heaven's harmony.'

units.zh: 及柩歸，命恭親王奠送，遣官到籍致祭，飾終之典，一時無與比。
units.en: When the coffin went home, Prince Gong was ordered to escort it; officials were sent to his native place for rites—funeral honors unequaled in the age.
units.literal: When the coffin returned home, Prince Gong was ordered to escort it with sacrifices; officials were sent to his native place for rites—the funeral honors were unmatched at the time.

units.zh: 徐桐五月戊辰遷。翁同龢左都御史。
units.en: On the wuchen day of the fifth month, Xu Tong was transferred. Weng Tonghe: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wuchen day of the fifth month, Xu Tong was transferred. Weng Tonghe: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 翁同龢正月庚午遷。潘祖蔭左都御史。三月乙卯遷。童華左都御史。
units.en: On the gengwu day of the first month, Weng Tonghe was transferred. Pan Zuyin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the third month, was transferred. Tong Hua: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the gengwu day of the first month, Weng Tonghe was transferred. Pan Zuyin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the third month, was transferred. Tong Hua: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 光緒四年戊寅
units.en: The fourth year of the Guangxu reign (wuyin).
units.literal: Guangxu year 4, wuyin.

units.zh: 光緒五年己卯
units.en: The fifth year of the Guangxu reign (jimao).
units.literal: Guangxu year 5, jimao.

units.zh: 六月乙亥，宋儒朱熹裔孫梃為翰林院世襲五經博士。
units.en: In the sixth month, on yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was appointed hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, Ting, descendant of the Song Confucian Zhu Xi, was made hereditary Five Classics doctor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 二十五年，大學士徐桐言電報局獲利不貲，並無裨益公家之實。
units.en: In 1899, Grand Secretary Xu Tong argued that the telegraph bureau reaped enormous profits while bringing no real benefit to the state.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Grand Secretary Xu Tong stated that the telegraph bureau reaped immeasurable profit yet brought no real benefit to the state.

units.zh: 十五年，大學士熊賜履票本有誤，改寫草簽，既又毀去。
units.en: In Kangxi 15 (1676) Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü's draft memorial was faulty; he rewrote it on a slip and then destroyed the slip.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü's draft memorial contained an error; he rewrote it on a slip and then destroyed it.

units.zh: 索額圖與大學士巴泰、杜立德等疏劾，賜履坐罷歸。
units.en: Songgotu joined Grand Secretaries Batai and Du Lide in impeaching him, and Cilü was dismissed and sent home.
units.literal: Songgotu, together with Grand Secretaries Batai, Du Lide, and others, memorialized in impeachment, and Cilü was dismissed and sent home.

units.zh: 時太常寺卿唐鑑講學京師，國籓與倭仁、吳廷棟、何桂珍嚴事之，治義理之學。
units.en: Tang Jian, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was then lecturing in the capital, and Guofan—along with Woren, Wu Tingdong, and He Guizhen—reverently attended him and pursued the Neo-Confucian study of moral principle.
units.literal: At that time Tang Jian, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, lectured in the capital; Guofan, together with Woren, Wu Tingdong, and He Guizhen, served him with strict reverence and studied the learning of moral principle.

units.zh: 二十三年，以檢討典試四川，再轉侍讀，累遷內閣學士、禮部侍郎，署兵部。
units.en: In the twenty-third year of the reign (1843), while serving as an Investigating Editor in the Hanlin Academy, he presided over the Sichuan provincial examinations. He was later made Reader-in-Waiting and rose in succession to Academician of the Grand Secretariat and Vice Minister of Rites, while concurrently overseeing the Ministry of War.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year (1843), as a reviser he conducted the provincial examination in Sichuan, was later transferred to reader-in-waiting, and was successively promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat and Vice Minister of Rites, while also acting as Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 羅惇衍二月甲申遷。雷以誠左副都御史。五月辛酉遷。周祖培左副都御史。十一月己酉遷。十二月乙酉龔文齡左副都御史。丙申遷。
units.en: On the jiashen day of the second month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Lei Yicheng: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the xinyou day of the fifth month, was transferred. Zhou Zupei: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the jiyou day of the eleventh month, was transferred. On the yiyou day of the twelfth month, Gong Wenling: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day, was transferred.
units.literal: On the jiashen day of the second month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Lei Yicheng: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the xinyou day of the fifth month, was transferred. Zhou Zupei: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the jiyou day of the eleventh month, was transferred. On the yiyou day of the twelfth month, Gong Wenling: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day, was transferred.

units.zh: 咸豐三年癸丑
units.en: Third year of Xianfeng (1853), guichou
units.literal: Third year of Xianfeng, guichou

units.zh: 朱鳳標二月己卯遷。周祖培左都御史。十一月庚寅遷。許乃普左都御史。
units.en: On the jimao day of the second month, Zhu Fengbiao was transferred. Zhou Zupei: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the gengyin day of the eleventh month, was transferred. Xu Naipu: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the jimao day of the second month, Zhu Fengbiao was transferred. Zhou Zupei: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the gengyin day of the eleventh month, was transferred. Xu Naipu: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 咸豐四年甲寅
units.en: Fourth year of Xianfeng (1854), jiayin
units.literal: Fourth year of Xianfeng, jiayin

units.zh: 請命山東巡撫李僡親往淮安扼賊北竄，並請敕直隸總督迅派布政使張集馨率兵扼要駐守，以為京師屏蔽。」
units.en: We ask that Governor Li Shen of Shandong be sent in person to Huai'an to block the rebels' northward advance, and that the Zhili governor-general be ordered to dispatch Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhang Jixin at once with troops to hold the strategic points that shield the capital."
units.literal: We ask that the Shandong governor Li Shen be ordered to go in person to Huai'an to block the rebels' northward flight, and that the Zhili governor-general be commanded to dispatch Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhang Jixin at once with troops to hold key points as a shield for the capital."

units.zh: 四年，醇郡王等訓練神機營兵及練兵三萬餘人，操演漸著成效，綠營亦就整肅。
units.en: In year 4 Prince Chun trained the Shenji Camp and over thirty thousand drilled men with growing success; the Green Standard grew orderly too.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Prince Chun and others trained Shenji Camp troops and more than thirty thousand drilled soldiers; drill gradually showed results, and the Green Standard also became orderly.

units.zh: 令仍隸醇郡王節制，督操閱兵大臣，一併閱看。
units.en: They stayed under Prince Chun, with drill and inspection ministers reviewing them together.
units.literal: They were ordered to remain under Prince Chun's command; ministers supervising drill and inspection would inspect them together.

units.zh: 羅惇衍七月庚子遷。李棠階左都御史。
units.en: On the gengzi day of the seventh month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Li Tangjie: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the gengzi day of the seventh month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Li Tangjie: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 李棠階遷。二月乙酉單懋謙左都御史。
units.en: Li Tangjie was transferred. On the yiyou day of the second month, Shan Maoqian: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Li Tangjie was transferred. On the yiyou day of the second month, Shan Maoqian: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 同治二年癸亥
units.en: Second year of the Tongzhi reign (guihai)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 2, guihai

units.zh: 書元四月左副都御史。
units.en: In the fourth month, Shuyuan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the fourth month, Shuyuan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 咸豐七年丁巳
units.en: Seventh year of Xianfeng (1857), dingsi
units.literal: Seventh year of Xianfeng, dingsi

units.zh: 靈桂六月乙丑遷。書元理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the yichou day of the sixth month, Linggui was transferred. Shuyuan: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the yichou day of the sixth month, Linggui was transferred. Shuyuan: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 咸豐八年戊午
units.en: Eighth year of Xianfeng (1858), wuwu
units.literal: Eighth year of Xianfeng, wuwu

units.zh: 書元六月遷。九月甲午成琦左副都御史。
units.en: In the sixth month, Shuyuan was transferred. On the jiawu day of the ninth month, Chengqi: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Shuyuan was transferred. On the jiawu day of the ninth month, Chengqi: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 書元六月壬子遷。察杭阿理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the renzi day of the sixth month, Shuyuan was transferred. Chahanga: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the renzi day of the sixth month, Shuyuan was transferred. Chahanga: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 咸豐九年己未
units.en: Ninth year of Xianfeng (1859), jiwei
units.literal: Ninth year of Xianfeng, jiwei

units.zh: 初服膺陸、王之學，繼參以程、硃、張、呂，不主一家。
units.en: He first embraced the learning of Lu Xiangshan and Wang Yangming, then drew also on Cheng Yi, Zhu Xi, Zhang Zai, and Lü Dalin, and did not commit himself to any one school alone.
units.literal: At first he adhered to the learning of Lu and Wang, then blended in Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü, and did not adhere to a single school.

units.zh: 伯淳在澤州，嘗三次食韭黃，始食懷州韭，次食澤州，次食并州，則知數百里間，氣候已爭三月矣。
units.en: At Zezhou, Bochun ate chives three times — from Huai, Ze, and Bing — and found climate three months apart within hundreds of li.
units.literal: Bochun at Zezhou once ate chive shoots three times — first Huai chives, then Ze chives, then Bing chives — and knew that within a few hundred li climate already differed by three months.

units.zh: 十三年，日本兵船窺伺台灣，偕總督​​李鶴年、船政大臣疏陳防務。
units.en: In Tongzhi 13 Japanese warships threatened Taiwan. With Governor-General Li Henian and the naval affairs minister he memorialized on coastal defense.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, Japanese warships watched for an opportunity against Taiwan; together with Governor-General Li Henian and the minister of naval administration he memorialized on coastal defense.

units.zh: 尋疏薦李棠階、吳廷棟、王慶雲、嚴正基、江忠源五人。
units.en: Soon afterward he submitted a memorial recommending Li Tangjie, Wu Tingdong, Wang Qingyun, Yan Zhengji, and Jiang Zhongyuan.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he memorialized recommending five men: Li Tangjie, Wu Tingdong, Wang Qingyun, Yan Zhengji, and Jiang Zhongyuan.

units.zh: 咸豐初，廣西兵事起，詔群臣言得失。
units.en: Early in the Xianfeng reign, rebellion flared in Guangxi, and the throne ordered the ministers to speak frankly on the empire's strengths and failures.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign, military troubles broke out in Guangxi, and an edict summoned the ministers to speak on what had been gained and lost.

units.zh: 察杭阿二月辛酉遷。增慶理藩院右侍郎。閏八月丙申慶明理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the xinyou day of the second month, Chahanga was transferred. Zengqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, Qingming: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the xinyou day of the second month, Chahanga was transferred. Zengqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, Qingming: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 五月，簽約退兵，遂命桂良偕花沙納赴上海，武備院卿明善、刑部員外郎段承實副之，會同兩江總督何桂清議稅則。
units.en: In the fifth month, after the treaty was signed and the armies withdrew, Gui Liang and Huashana were sent to Shanghai with Mingshan and Duan Chengshi as deputies to work with Governor-General He Guiqing on the tariff schedule.
units.literal: In the fifth month, after signing the treaty the armies withdrew; Gui Liang was then ordered to go with Huashana to Shanghai, with Director of the Armory Mingshan and Vice Director of Punishments Duan Chengshi as deputies, to join Governor-General He Guiqing of the Two Jiangs in deliberating tariffs.

units.zh: 桂清力言免稅之不可，改約之難成，桂良亦贊其議，上甚怒，必責其補救一二端，而各國因廣東民團仍與為難，且出示偽載諭旨，堅欲罷兩廣總督黃宗漢，停撤民團。
units.en: He Guiqing argued forcefully that duty waivers were impossible and treaty revision unrealistic; Gui Liang agreed. The emperor was furious and demanded some concession in return. Meanwhile the powers, citing clashes with Guangdong militia and even a forged imperial edict, insisted on removing Governor-General Huang Zonghan and keeping the militia intact.
units.literal: He Guiqing strongly argued that duty exemption was impossible and treaty revision hard to achieve; Gui Liang also endorsed his view. The emperor was greatly angry and insisted they make up for it in one or two points. Meanwhile the foreign powers, because Guangdong militia still clashed with them, even produced a falsely printed imperial edict and firmly demanded the dismissal of Governor-General Huang Zonghan of the Two Guangs and a halt to disbanding the militia.

units.zh: 桂良等疏聞，乃解宗漢通商大臣，改授桂清。
units.en: When Gui Liang reported this to court, Huang Zonghan was removed as trade commissioner and He Guiqing was appointed in his place.
units.literal: Gui Liang and the others memorialized the throne; Huang Zonghan was then removed as commissioner of trade and the post was given to He Guiqing.
